'''Wardpost Hurne''' was a military outpost of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] located in the [[Glarus Valley]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
